## Overview
### Introduction to OpenAI o1
The OpenAI o1 model, released by OpenAI on 2024-12-17, is a premium, non-open-source language model designed to handle complex tasks. Its architecture is tailored to provide high-performance capabilities, including text generation, function calling, structured outputs, streaming, batch processing, system prompts, and extended thinking. With a context window of 200,000 tokens and a maximum output of 100,000 tokens, OpenAI o1 is well-suited for tasks that require in-depth analysis and reasoning.

### Technical Strengths and Use Cases
OpenAI o1 boasts impressive benchmark scores, including 92.3 on MMLU, 94.4 on HumanEval, 1330 on LMSYS Arena ELO, and 99.5 on GSM8K. These scores demonstrate the model's exceptional capabilities in complex reasoning, math, science, coding, and research. It is particularly suited for PhD-level problems, legal analysis, and financial modeling. However, it is not recommended for simple tasks, high-volume applications, low-latency requirements, vision tasks, or budget-conscious projects. The pricing model for OpenAI o1 includes input costs of $15.0 per 1M tokens, output costs of $60.0 per 1M tokens, and discounted rates for cached input and batch input at $7.5 per 1M tokens.

#### Optimal Usage Scenarios
